title: Health and illness
descriptionFa: گفتن حال خودت، بیماری‌های رایج و جدی، و عادت‌های سالم.

words.example: I'm very well, thank you.
words.tipFa: I don't feel very well یعنی «حالم زیاد خوب نیست»؛ معمولاً چیز جدی‌ای نیست.

words.example: I'm fine, thanks. And you?
I feel ill. Can you call a doctor, please?
words.tipFa: از I don't feel well جدی‌تره.

words.example: I ate too much cake and I felt sick.
words.tipFa: در انگلیسی بریتانیایی be sick یعنی «بالا آوردن». در آمریکا sick همون «مریض» هست.

words.example: You should see a doctor about that cough.
Loud music always gives me a headache.
words.tipFa: با a می‌گیم: I've got a headache. تلفظ ache: «اِیک».

words.example: Take an aspirin and lie down for an hour.
I can't eat anything. I've got toothache.
words.tipFa: بریتانیایی‌ها معمولاً بدون a می‌گن: I've got toothache.

words.example: I go to the dentist twice a year.
I've got a cold, so I'm staying at home today.
words.tipFa: سرما خوردن: catch a cold. cold صفت هم هست یعنی «سرد».

words.example: My hay fever is terrible every spring.
Cats always make me sneeze.
words.tipFa: وقتی کسی عطسه می‌کنه، می‌گن Bless you! (عافیت باشه).

words.example: My cousin has asthma, so she always carries an inhaler.
A mosquito kept me awake all night.
In some hot countries, mosquitoes carry malaria.
Dirty drinking water can cause cholera.
Smoking can cause lung cancer.
My uncle is in hospital after a car accident.
words.tipFa: بریتانیایی‌ها بدون the می‌گن: in hospital, go to hospital.

words.example: My grandfather had a heart attack last year.
words.tipFa: had a heart attack، نه got a heart attack.

words.example: A healthy diet has lots of fruit and vegetables.
words.tipFa: diet یعنی «چیزهایی که معمولاً می‌خوری»، نه فقط رژیم لاغری.

words.example: I exercise three times a week.
words.tipFa: اسم هم هست: Exercise is important.

words.example: Eat your vegetables. They're good for you!
words.tipFa: Good for you! با لحن تشویق یعنی «آفرین بهت!» هم هست.

words.example: I always feel stressed before exams.
On Fridays I just relax at home with a book.
Don't panic! The exam is easier than you think.

gapQuestions.hintFa: یه حشره‌ی کوچیک که نیش می‌زنه.
